body.message:
Please note that, as per the latest update from our team, the building security may not allow a large mattress to be brought into the apartment. Only a foldable mattress is permitted.

We will update the moving company details when we register your move-in information with the building tomorrow, along with your check-in details.

However, kindly note that we are unable to confirm in advance whether the building security will allow a large mattress to be brought into the apartment.
